column1: # The words that two sentences of the hard set (eval/data/hard_set.tsv) must not share within one call (README.md).
# From the target words of eval/tts_readings/targets.tsv and the hard set's notes, with the same word in another
# spelling given one name (1日 = 一日, 3日 = 三日, 8日 = 八日, 20日 = 二十日, 4月 = 四月), and, where in doubt, a wider
# group: 上手く and 下手 with 上手 (the same 手 compounds), the counters 本, 分 and 人 (their sound changes), 何本 with 何.
# Sentences not listed share no such word with another sentence.
